sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Stripe offers the most unified and developer-centric financial stack, allowing businesses to scale from their first transaction to billions in volume on a single set of APIs.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Stripe is a global financial infrastructure company that provides a suite of tools for businesses to accept payments and manage revenue. Its platform supports everything from online checkouts and physical point-of-sale systems to complex revenue models and financial service integrations.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Global payment processing
billing/subscription management
platform/marketplace infrastructure
card issuing
tax automation
and point-of-sale hardware.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Usage-based (per transaction) and Subscription options for advanced features.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Startups, global e-commerce platforms, software-as-a-service (SaaS) providers, and large-scale enterprises.
